title.zh: 创建数据迁移定时任务

descriptions.zh:
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解了数据传输服务独享资源组和弹性预留计算资源的<props="china">[收费方式和价格](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/product-overview/data-transfer-fees-hourly-billing)</props>
<props="intl">[收费方式和价格](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/product-overview/data-transfer-fees-hourly-billing)</props>。
descriptions.en: Before you call this API, make sure you understand the <props="china">[billing methods and pricing](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/product-overview/data-transfer-fees-hourly-billing)</props><props="intl">[billing methods and pricing](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/product-overview/data-transfer-fees-hourly-billing)</props> for dedicated resource groups and elastic reserved computing resources in the Data Transmission Service.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun maxcompute create-mms-timer --source-id 2000014 --name planA --src-db-name src_db --partitions 1232 --tables t1 --table-black-list t1 --table-white-list t1 --partition-filters key=example-string --enable-schema-migration true --enable-data-migration true --enable-verification false --table-mapping key=example-string --column-mapping key=example-string --others key=example-string --value 12:00 --schedule-type Daily --region cn-hangzhou
